input: how much of the research is a verifiable repeatable experiment versus a made up thing do a report and blog post and agent and human and report on that on that.
task: Reproducibility audit of research/: repeatable experiment vs made up
errors: pkill -f with a pattern that also matched the calling shell killed the shell twice (exit 144)
Full alphabetical re-run reached 23 of 761 before the user asked to finish; switched to seeded random order
CI red twice from main (code ref to a file added later; feedback/ page failing check.mjs); resolved by merging main and porting PR #8779

doc_friction.issue: Runs only the homepage build; none of the 6,197 research tests run in CI, which the audit found by running them.
run.py error says 'sh fetch_pdk.sh pdk (in this directory)' but the project has no fetch_pdk.sh.

deviations.why: The audit lives in research/_audit/ (not a project directory) so it does not add itself to the projects it audits; no projects.json/README bullet added.

notes: Hand check 40/40 headline numbers match; 10,518/11,985 README numbers (88%) found in own committed output vs 5% shuffled control; re-ran 32 projects (16 exact, 1 differs: ambient-bandit Thompson rows, numpy/LAPACK-dependent multivariate_normal; rest setup/timeouts) pooled with swe-audit: 102/103 finished reproduced; tests 220/231 pass. Input basis of 40: math 17, assumed 14, real-tool 5, repo-data 2, cited 2, external 0. Census and remaining tests left as action items in research/_audit/README.md. Handoff steps for the next agent: research/_audit/NEXT.md. Verification (CI runners slow, ~30 min queue): run_workflow_locally.py --for-changes: 8/13 workflows passed; not run: agent-cross-review (4 reviewer jobs), hetzner hcloud-scope, portfolio-pages deploy, publish-pages-branch (secrets/deploy). Pages build + check.mjs dist locally: publishable, 1305 products, 3816 pages, no dead links. Ported PR #8779's feedback/ fix after main's Pages check went red on PR #8723's page; merged main for the site-feedback.json code ref.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: re-running ~30 projects, hand-checking 40 READMEs, writing report and post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
